claim: BrainCaseDB must not automatically ingest requests, turns, sessions, telemetry, stream events, or recovery state. All BrainCaseDB write paths must be explicit memory tool actions.
summary: BrainCaseDB is not an automatic ingestion target. Records may only be written through explicit paths: manual/user-approved save, future promotion pipeline, future memory extractor, future StateRecord creation, explicit test fixture, or narrow provenance/scoping support attached to an actual stored memory/state record.
